title: Phase C audit R2 — three residual findings closed on top of the R1 audit fixes
description: Audit R2 closure for PR #113 (BASE staging/pr59-safe@69d1c9b, on top of R1 commit 2f2671c). R2-F1: planner monetary admission now prices the COMPLETE per-candidate provider-request envelope via the new shared plannerCandidateRequestBound() exported from planner-pool.ts — codex_cli candidates bound at 6 (INITIAL+REASK plan calls + 2 eligibility re-proofs x 2 possible qualification-refresh probes), HTTP/LLM candidates at 3 (2 internal INITIAL requests + 1 REASK); serve-mission-control.mjs replaces the legacy (INITIAL+REASK=2) hand-derived multiplier with this structural constant so a METERED_API reserve prices worst-case spend (100u x 6 = 600u) and admission can never under-reserve. R2-F2: codex qualification/refresh probes consume the ONE run deadline — runPlannerFailover passes its absolute deadlineMs as runCtx into assertEligible (both the pre-INITIAL and pre-REASK re-proof); serve-mission-control threads it into refreshCodexPlannerQualification, which fails closed with typed FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_DEADLINE before any probe can start at/after the deadline, min()s each probe timeout against the remaining window, and honestly counts only probes that provably initiated (partial spend); provider-validation.ts propagates FAIL_CLOSED_* authority-typed probe errors instead of fabricating UNREACHABLE probe_state evidence for a probe that never ran. R2-F3: BusinessLayer.prepareDelegatedPlan now runs assertBudgetHeadroom — a strictly read-only re-application of reserveBudget()'s scope/period/usage scan over missions + live HELD reservations — BEFORE deps.planExpander, so a definitely-exhausted hard-stop mission-count budget rejects with FAIL_CLOSED_BUDGET_EXCEEDED at zero planner calls and zero reservation writes; the atomic reserveBudget() inside openWorkItem remains the final authority against races. No Phase C R3 semantics changed; Telegram HOTFIX A-D untouched; tests: 10-case regression file pair-phase-c-audit-r2.test.ts.
